protocol.physics: fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic two-proton two-electron Coulomb; full spatial singlet; EBO=Ee+1/R
protocol.stage_A: independent Cartesian Hermite Gaussian recurrence at 60/80 decimal digits; same stored binary64 exponents, radial coefficients and real-solid-harmonic polynomial coefficients, integrated independently; largest weighted AO antisymmetry term class at the worst Cholesky/common-AO singlet coupling, plus largest raw S antisymmetry class
protocol.stage_B_gate: Independent permutations agree to 1e-45, 60/80 evaluations agree to 1e-45, libcint permutation differences nonzero, and the chosen class contributes at least 1 percent of the 1e-10 H guard. This is a diagnostic significance gate, not a relaxed numerical guard.
protocol.canonical_rule: AO pair (max(i,j),min(i,j)); pair index i*(i+1)/2+j. ERI canonical quartet has descending pair indices. No averaging or value-dependent choice. Unique lower-triangle one-electron quantities are evaluated once and copied. PySCF s8 integral driver stores one ERI representative per eightfold class; compact=True transform evaluates one MO within-pair representative and restores its equal within-pair permutations. MO pair interchange is NOT averaged or enforced.
protocol.stage_B: diagnose AO reuse with full uncompressed transformation, then symmetry-aware compact transformation. Both fixed here before evaluation. Cholesky full dimension only. Transformed h lower-triangle bilinear quantity is evaluated once and reused by its exact transpose identity, separately labelled.
protocol.stage_C: only if A gate passes and B supports symmetry-aware representation; four points only; full original singlet assembly and original guards, no H averaging
protocol.minimum: Use accepted new 1.3/1.4 and archived accepted 1.5. Resolve 0.1 bohr sampled LOCAL minimum only if both neighbours have greater energy. If 1.3<=1.4 stop without expanding.
